correctness.rationale: Condition on last car n in space j: its choice is any of j preferences, previous labels split into independent left and right valid parking blocks, and cross-block inversions contribute (−1)^(n−j+I(L)). Summing over label subsets gives G(n−1,j−1)=[n−1 choose j−1]_{−1}. Thus S_n=Σ_j j(−1)^(n−j)G S_{j−1}S_{n−j}. Separating even/odd coefficients gives O=E²+2zEE′ and E′=E³+8zE²E′+4z²E²E″ (formal series E0=1). Coefficient induction uses only previous positive E_i and a strictly positive E³ contribution; O follows positive convolution. Independently enumerated preference tuples n=1..6 and confirmed totals (n+1)^(n−1) and signed counts 1,1,4,11,72,335; exact recurrence/formal equations corroborated to further coefficients. Infinite positivity comes from the algebraic formal-series proof, not finite enumerations. Preference word inversion is not outcome sign.
